parameters.name: AdviceDate
parameters.description: The date when the suggestion is generated. Specify the date in the yyyyMMdd format. The date must be in UTC.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb apply-advice-by-id --db-cluster-id am-uf6g8w25jacm70000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --advice-id 0baf1f52-53df-487f-8292-99a037160000 --advice-date 20221101 --apply-type DROP_INDEX --build-immediately false --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb ApplyAdviceById --region cn-hangzhou --ApplyType DROP_INDEX --BuildImmediately false --DBClusterId 'am-uf6g8w25jacm70000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AdviceId '0baf1f52-53df-487f-8292-99a037160000' --AdviceDate 20221101
